contracts.rule: Discovery MUST treat native package, Flatpak, Snap, AppImage, portable and manual instances as parallel installation identities rather than mutually exclusive global states.
Package registration, PATH visibility or desktop-entry presence MUST NOT be treated as runtime health; a consumer requiring execution MUST obtain a bounded physical health probe.
A broken candidate MUST remain observable as UNHEALTHY and MUST NOT satisfy a Current Host execution prerequisite.
Discovery and qualification selection MUST NOT become user runtime selection authority and MUST NOT silently replace an explicitly selected application.
Application discovery MUST NOT install, update, remove, replace, hijack MIME/default associations, mutate global environment, or require upstream application uninstall.
Desktop-entry execution discovery may accept only direct executable commands; shell or privilege-escalation wrappers are not an admissible discovery shortcut.
Manual and portable paths MUST be explicit configuration inputs; arbitrary recursive filesystem execution discovery is forbidden.
Preflight and physical producer code for the same application requirement MUST resolve through the same shared runtime resolver.
